summary: Iteration 9 — verified CRM 2.0 (contact enrichment + multi-call history detail sheet + summary/transcript dialogs) and Campaigns 2.0 (analytics per card, queue sheet with Contacted/Upcoming tabs, audience & schedule selectors in New Campaign dialog). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass. Frontend: all UI expectations from the review request pass. 3CX live-call actions (campaign-dial-next, call-lead buttons) were verified to RENDER but were deliberately NOT triggered as instructed.
verified_passing: GET /api/contacts => each row enriched with call_count, last_call_rating, last_call_summary, last_call_campaign, last_call_date
GET /api/contacts/{id} for 'Tom O'Brien' => calls[] enriched with campaign_name, rating, summary, next_action; call_count == 1
GET /api/campaigns => each item includes analytics {times_used, avg_rating, positive_rate, sentiment}
GET /api/campaigns/{id}/queue => {contacted, upcoming, contacted_count, upcoming_count, next, audience} — counts match array lengths
POST /api/campaigns with audience='positive', schedule_type='scheduled', scheduled_at persists and reflects in list response
Leads UI: columns Name/Company/Phone/Email/Status/Rating/Last summary/Campaign/Last call/Actions all present
Leads UI: 'Tom O'Brien' row shows '(1 call)' badge; clicking row opens detail sheet with call-history-<callid> entries
Leads UI: view-summary-<callid> opens data-testid='call-viewer-dialog' with summary + NEXT ACTION section
Leads UI: view-transcript-<callid> opens same dialog rendering chat bubbles ('AI AGENT ...')
Campaigns UI: each card shows audience badge (e.g., ALL LEADS / POSITIVE RESPONDERS) + 3 metrics grid (TIMES USED, AVG RATING, POSITIVE)
Campaigns UI: campaign-queue-<id> opens campaign-queue-sheet with Contacted/Upcoming counts + queue-tab-upcoming / queue-tab-contacted tabs
Campaigns UI: New Campaign dialog exposes campaign-audience selector and campaign-schedule-type selector; picking 'scheduled' reveals campaign-scheduled-at datetime input, picking 'manual' hides it
Campaigns UI: creating 'QA Test Campaign' with audience=positive → appears in list with 'POSITIVE RESPONDERS' badge (screenshot captured, then cleaned up via API DELETE returning 200)
safety_notes: campaign-dial-next button was located and confirmed present; NOT clicked (would place a real 3CX call)
call-lead-<id> and call-lead-detail-button in Leads were NOT clicked; only their presence confirmed
No POST /api/campaigns/{id}/dial-next and no POST /api/calls/dial were issued
action_items: No blocking action items for CRM 2.0 / Campaigns 2.0. Prior iter8 minor issue (telephony._get_token cache key excludes client_secret) remains and is unrelated to this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: routes._enrich_call correctly falls back to analysis.score / analysis.summary — resilient to legacy call docs.
routes.list_contacts issues one batched find over calls (via {'contact_id': {'$in': ids}}) instead of N per-contact queries — good.
routes.campaign_queue de-duplicates contacted contacts by first-seen (latest call per contact due to sort) — correct semantics.
routes.campaign_dial_next reuses campaign_queue() internally to pick next contact — nice DRY reuse; guarded by tcx_enabled and audit-logged.
Leads.jsx: view-summary/transcript buttons are correctly disabled when the call has no summary/transcript (verified enabled-only click loop works).
Campaigns.jsx uses CSS-uppercase for metric labels — assertions must be case-insensitive; UI-side text matches spec case in source ('Times used', 'Avg rating', 'Positive').

campaign-scheduled-at input is a native <input type='datetime-local'> — this is acceptable for a scheduling field per app conventions (not a shadcn calendar), and it correctly appears only when schedule_type='scheduled'.
models.CampaignCreate correctly makes audience/schedule_type/scheduled_at optional so pre-existing 'manual' campaigns without scheduled_at continue to work.
seed_data_creation: Created 'QA Test Campaign' during UI test then cleaned up via DELETE /api/campaigns/{id} (status 200). No other seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for CRM 2.0 + Campaigns 2.0 read/create paths: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_crm_campaigns.py. All Playwright selectors used in the review request (view-summary-<id>, view-transcript-<id>, call-viewer-dialog, campaign-queue-<id>, campaign-queue-sheet, queue-tab-upcoming/contacted, campaign-audience, campaign-schedule-type, campaign-scheduled-at) resolve correctly. IMPORTANT: 3CX live calling is enabled on the demo org — never trigger campaign-dial-next, call-lead-<id>, or call-lead-detail-button; only verify render.
rca of the issue: No new bugs. Both P1 features are working end-to-end. Any test failures observed during the initial Playwright run were purely due to the tester's case-sensitive substring checks vs CSS-uppercased labels; the underlying UI text matches the spec.
